$comment: PalSchema loader-implemented keys. These are consumed by PalSchema's mod loaders (src/Loader/*.cpp), NOT fields of any UE row struct, so the SDK-header pipeline can never derive them. scripts/apply-loader-overlay.mjs merges the pals entries into schemas/v1.0/DT_PalMonsterParameter.schema.json; scripts/derive-loader-schemas.mjs builds schemas/v1.0/PalStaticItemData.schema.json from the UPalStaticItemData* class headers and merges the items entries in. Every entry is read off PalSchema's source files named in verifiedAgainst, never off a PR title or release note.

pals.note: The pal loader's property loop has no failure/warning branch: a key that is neither a loader key nor a DT_PalMonsterParameter member is silently dropped in game. Open issue: https://github.com/Okaetsu/PalSchema/issues/134

items.fileShape: { "<ItemId>": { <UPalStaticItemData* class fields + the items entries below> } } — a null value deletes the item
items.note: Since PalSchema 0.6.3 the item loader logs Warning "Property '<key>' not found in Item '<id>'" at load time. https://github.com/Okaetsu/PalSchema/pull/138

raw.note: The raw table loader has always warned ("Property ... not found") and increments its error count.

advisories.message: SortId on NEW items has no effect before PalSchema 0.6.4; edits to existing items are unaffected

entries.sinceNote: when adding new pals; edits to existing pals are unaffected
entries.note: PR #143 is a single added line (PalMonsterModLoader.cpp:181) that runs HandleRanchSuitability on the NEW-pal path; the edit path already ran it. Key name, the WorkSuitability_MonsterFarm >= 1 gate, the must-be-an-object check and the nested property list all come from HandleRanchSuitability in src/Loader/PalMonsterModLoader.cpp.

schema.description: Ranch (SpawnItem) action config, processed by PalSchema's pal loader for pals whose WorkSuitability_MonsterFarm is >= 1. Adding it to a NEW pal requires PalSchema >= 0.6.4 (https://github.com/Okaetsu/PalSchema/pull/143); edits to existing pals ran this earlier. Properties are copied onto the generated BP_Action_SpawnItem class; keys outside this list are silently ignored in game.

ChargeMontage.description: Copied onto the generated spawn action (blueprint-defined property; type not constrained here).

FunMontage.description: Copied onto the generated spawn action (blueprint-defined property; type not constrained here).

ChargeFacialEye.description: Copied onto the generated spawn action (blueprint-defined property; type not constrained here).

FunFacialEye.description: Copied onto the generated spawn action (blueprint-defined property; type not constrained here).

SpawnSocketName.description: Copied onto the generated spawn action (blueprint-defined property; type not constrained here).

SpawnLocationOffset.description: Copied onto the generated spawn action (blueprint-defined property; type not constrained here).

SpawnItemRotator.description: Copied onto the generated spawn action (blueprint-defined property; type not constrained here).

entries.note: New pal: adds a DT_PalCharacterIconDataTable row. Existing pal: replaces the icon on its existing row.

schema.description: Icon texture asset path, e.g. /Game/Pal/Texture/PalIcon/Normal/T_MyPal_icon_normal.T_MyPal_icon_normal — PalSchema pal-loader key, not a row-struct field.

entries.note: New pals only: adds the DT_PalBPClass row pointing at the pal's character blueprint.

schema.description: Character blueprint asset path for a NEW pal (adds the DT_PalBPClass row) — PalSchema pal-loader key, not a row-struct field.

entries.note: Existing pals only: rewrites the BPClass of the pal's existing DT_PalBPClass row.

schema.description: Replacement character blueprint class path for an EXISTING pal — PalSchema pal-loader key, not a row-struct field.

entries.note: AddAbilities: each entry needs WazaID (string) and Level (integer) or the loader logs an error and skips it.

schema.description: Abilities the pal unlocks by level; each entry becomes a DT_WazaMasterLevel row — PalSchema pal-loader key, not a row-struct field.

WazaID.description: EPalWazaID name, e.g. EPalWazaID::FireBall or FireBall.

entries.note: AddLoot: builds one DT_PalDropItem row; entries past the 10th are ignored (the row has 10 slots). DropChance must be a float literal — the loader checks is_number_float() and skips the entry on a bare integer.

schema.description: Drop table for the pal; becomes a DT_PalDropItem row (max 10 slots, later entries ignored) — PalSchema pal-loader key, not a row-struct field.

DropChance.description: PalSchema requires a float literal here (e.g. 100.0, not 100) — the loader skips the entry otherwise. JSON.parse erases the distinction, so the validator checks the raw text instead of this schema.

entries.note: Writes the PAL_NAME_<CharacterId> row of DT_PalNameText (all languages).

schema.description: Display name; becomes the PAL_NAME_<CharacterId> translation row — PalSchema pal-loader key, not a row-struct field.

entries.note: Writes the PAL_SHORT_DESC_<CharacterId> row of DT_PalShortDescriptionText.

schema.description: Short Paldeck description; becomes the PAL_SHORT_DESC_<CharacterId> translation row — PalSchema pal-loader key, not a row-struct field.

entries.note: Writes the PAL_LONG_DESC_<CharacterId> row of DT_PalLongDescriptionText.

schema.description: Long Paldeck description; becomes the PAL_LONG_DESC_<CharacterId> translation row — PalSchema pal-loader key, not a row-struct field.

entries.note: Required by the loader when the ItemId is NOT an existing item (it throws without it); edits to existing items do not need it. Both the short and the class-name spellings are accepted.

schema.description: Item class for a NEW item (required when adding, ignored when editing) — PalSchema item-loader key.

entries.note: Writes the ITEM_NAME_<ItemId> row of DT_ItemNameText (all languages).

schema.description: Display name; becomes the ITEM_NAME_<ItemId> translation row — PalSchema item-loader key.

entries.note: Writes the ITEM_DESC_<ItemId> row of DT_ItemDescriptionText.

schema.description: Item description; becomes the ITEM_DESC_<ItemId> translation row — PalSchema item-loader key.

entries.note: AddRecipe/EditRecipe copy these keys onto a DT_ItemRecipeDataTable row (Product_Id is set from the ItemId; Editor_RowNameHash is skipped). The validator checks the object against the DT_ItemRecipeDataTable schema.

schema.description: Crafting recipe; becomes/edits the item's DT_ItemRecipeDataTable row (validated against that table's schema) — PalSchema item-loader key.

entries.note: Spelling used by PalSchema's own items authoring schema; the class property is SortId (UE FName lookups are case-insensitive, both work). On NEW items this only takes effect from PalSchema 0.6.4 (PR #128).

schema.description: Inventory sort order; written to the item's DT_ItemDataTable row. On NEW items this only functions from PalSchema 0.6.4 (https://github.com/Okaetsu/PalSchema/pull/128) — PalSchema item-loader key.

entries.note: AddItemData copies it onto the new DT_ItemDataTable row; defaults to true when omitted. PalSchema 0.6.5 (PR #145) added it to IsCustomProperty, which is what stopped the spurious in-game unknown-property warnings; the key itself worked before that.

schema.description: Written to the new item's DT_ItemDataTable row (default true) — PalSchema item-loader key.
